---
name: Specification change
about: Propose a change to hashing, canonicalisation, checkpoints, events or layer semantics
labels: spec
---

**What would change**
Which SPEC.md sections, and whether existing logs would verify differently.

**Why**
The problem this solves. Link to prior art (RFCs, C2SP, other projects) if any.

**Version strings**
Which version string (`v`, `spec`, signing domain, origin prefix) must change so old verifiers fail closed.

**Vectors**
The `pass-*` / `fail-*` vectors that would pin the new behaviour.
